points.title: Legal full-strobe write Setup
points.condition: Setup edge (psel=1, penable=0) with aligned address, pwrite=1 and pstrb=4'b1111.

points.title: Legal read Setup
points.condition: Setup edge with aligned address and pwrite=0.

points.title: Misaligned read Setup
points.condition: Setup edge with pwrite=0 and paddr[1:0]!=0.

points.title: Misaligned write with full strobe Setup
points.condition: Setup edge with pwrite=1, pstrb=4'b1111 and paddr[1:0]!=0.

points.title: Aligned write with PSTRB zero Setup
points.condition: Setup edge with aligned address, pwrite=1 and pstrb=4'b0000.

points.title: Aligned write with partial PSTRB Setup
points.condition: Setup edge with aligned address, pwrite=1 and pstrb neither 0 nor 4'b1111.

points.title: Aligned read with PSTRB not full (ignored)
points.condition: Setup edge with aligned address, pwrite=0 and pstrb!=4'b1111.

points.title: Legal Setup at highest word address
points.condition: Legal Setup edge with all address bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] set.

points.title: Write completes in 3 Access cycles with PRDATA 0
points.condition: PREADY edge for a write after 2 earlier Access cycles, no PSLVERR, PRDATA=0.

points.title: Read completes in 3 Access cycles
points.condition: PREADY edge for a read after 2 earlier Access cycles, no PSLVERR.

points.title: Write with same-cycle response, 2 Access cycles
points.condition: PREADY edge for a write after 1 earlier Access cycle without PSLVERR.

points.title: Read with same-cycle response, 2 Access cycles
points.condition: PREADY edge for a read after 1 earlier Access cycle without PSLVERR.

points.title: Local error completion in 1 Access cycle
points.condition: PREADY edge in the first Access cycle with PSLVERR=1 and PRDATA=0.

points.title: Channel A back-pressure
points.condition: a_valid=1 and a_ready=0.

points.title: Channel A accepted after 3 or more stall cycles
points.condition: a_valid and a_ready both 1 after at least 3 consecutive stall cycles.

points.title: Response in acceptance cycle after back-pressure
points.condition: Acceptance edge following at least 1 stall cycle with d_valid=1 at the same edge.

points.title: Response delayed 1 to 3 cycles after acceptance
points.condition: Counted response where the request was pending for 1 to 3 cycles earlier.

points.title: Response delayed 8 or more cycles
points.condition: Counted response where the request was pending for at least 8 cycles earlier.

points.title: Write response with d_error
points.condition: Counted response for a write with d_error=1, correct opcode and source.

points.title: Read response with d_error
points.condition: Counted response for a read with d_error=1, correct opcode and source.

points.title: Write answered with AccessAckData
points.condition: Counted response for a write with d_opcode=3'b001.

points.title: Read answered with AccessAck
points.condition: Counted response for a read with d_opcode=3'b000.

points.title: Undefined d_opcode on a counted response
points.condition: Counted response with d_opcode greater than 3'b001.

points.title: Wrong d_source on a counted response
points.condition: Counted response with d_source!=PARA_SRC_ID.

points.title: Orphan response while APB idle
points.condition: d_valid=1, not a counted response, and psel=0.

points.title: Orphan response during Setup or blocked channel A
points.condition: d_valid=1, not counted, and either Setup phase or a_valid=1 with a_ready=0.

points.title: Orphan response in the PREADY cycle
points.condition: d_valid=1, not counted, with o_apb_pready=1.

points.title: No response for 16 or more Access cycles
points.condition: Access cycle without PREADY after at least 16 earlier Access cycles.

points.title: Ignored response fields non-default
points.condition: Counted response with d_param nonzero, d_size!=2, d_sink nonzero or d_user nonzero.

points.title: Non-zero PPROT on a legal Setup
points.condition: Legal Setup edge with pprot!=0.

points.title: Back-to-back write then read, PSEL held
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous transfer a legal write, new one a legal read.

points.title: Back-to-back read then write, PSEL held
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous transfer a legal read, new one a legal write.

points.title: Back-to-back legal then illegal
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous transfer legal, new one illegal.

points.title: Back-to-back illegal then legal
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous transfer illegal, new one legal.

points.title: Back-to-back illegal then illegal
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous and new transfers both illegal.

points.title: Recovery after reset during pending a_valid
points.condition: PREADY of a new transfer after a reset that hit while a_valid was high, the new Setup seen after release.

points.title: Recovery after reset while waiting for response
points.condition: PREADY of a new transfer after a reset that hit while a request was accepted and awaiting a response, the new Setup seen after release.

points.title: Setup at first edge after reset release
points.condition: Setup edge where reset was asserted at the previous edge.

points.title: d_valid at first edge after reset release
points.condition: d_valid=1 at the first edge after reset release.

points.title: Back-to-back write then write, PSEL held
points.condition: Setup in the cycle after PREADY, previous transfer a legal write, new one a legal write.
